transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
I've been having trouble sleeping, and it's been going on for about three months now. I'm feeling pretty exhausted most days because of it.
When did you first notice it?
It started about three months ago, not long after I retired. That's when I first began noticing it.
Is there anything that makes it better or worse?
Yes, it's worse if I've had a late evening watching telly. But on days when I've been out for a long walk, I seem to sleep a bit better.
How would you describe the feeling in your own words?
Just shattered, really. I get so tired during the day that I can't be bothered with much, and it's been getting me down a bit too.
Where exactly do you feel it, and does it spread anywhere?
I'm not sure what you mean — I don't really have any pain. It's just the tiredness from not sleeping.
On a scale from 0 to 10, where 10 is the worst, how bad is it?
I'd say about a 7 out of 10. I'm only getting around four hours of sleep a night.
Is it there all the time, or does it come and go?
I just can't get off to sleep at all at night — that's the main thing.
Has anything else been bothering you along with this?
My mood has been quite low at times since I retired, though nothing too serious — I've not had any thoughts of harming myself. Other than that, I do get quite dozy in the chair in the afternoon.
Do you see a doctor regularly for any health condition?
Yes, I've got high blood pressure and an enlarged prostate that I'm being treated for.
Which medicines do you take regularly, including any new ones?

I take losartan 50 mg once a day for my blood pressure, and tamsulosin 400 micrograms at night for the prostate. I've also been taking some over-the-counter sleeping tablets from the pharmacy — diphenhydramine — most nights for the last three weeks.
Are you allergic to any medicines?
No, I don't have any allergies to medicines that I know of.
Has this changed what you can do around the house or outside?
Yes, I'm too tired to get much done on my allotment these days, and I often doze off in the chair in the afternoon.
Is there anything about this that worries you?
I'd really like to get something proper from the doctor to help me sleep — these over-the-counter ones don't seem to be doing the job.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
